requirement: Every discovered requirement ID must have a readable UTF-8 JSON file at `evidence/ID.json`.
justification: Scenarios: absent per-ID file, unreadable/non-UTF8 contents, invalid JSON, and correct evidence. validate constructs evidence/ID.json and reads UTF-8 before deserialization; the tests exercise missing files, invalid bytes, and malformed syntax as failures tied to the requirement. Validated with cargo test --locked --offline --manifest-path language-lab-ci/Cargo.toml (20 tests passing). Each cited test uses isolated fixture files and asserts outcomes, not merely the presence of instructions.
